name: bookotil
description: Find and book hotels in Algeria with live availability.

interface.longDescription: Search hotels anywhere in Algeria — Algiers, Oran, Constantine, the Sahara and more — with live availability for your dates. See photos, rooms, prices and cancellation terms, then book: bookotil prepares your booking and you pay on bookotil.com's secure page.
defaultPrompt: Find a hotel in Oran for 2 people next month.
Which hotels in Ghardaïa include breakfast?
Show me hotels near Algiers airport.

positive.description: Find hotels in a city for dates
positive.prompt: Find me a hotel in Oran for 2 adults, arriving in three weeks for 2 nights.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows 3–8 hotels bookable for those dates as cards with the price per night, the total for the stay (taxes included) and the cancellation terms.

positive.prompt: Show me the rooms and prices of the first hotel.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the hotel with photos and every bookable room with its exact total, breakfast and free-cancellation date.

positive.prompt: What is the cheapest hotel in Algiers with breakfast for 2 nights in a month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the cheapest bookable hotels sorted by price, quoting only prices returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Book the cheapest double room at that hotel for those dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a booking summary card (hotel, room, dates, guests, total, cancellation) with a « Pay securely » button that opens bookotil.com's checkout with the stay pre-filled. Nothing is booked or charged in the chat.

positive.description: Check whether the booking went through
positive.prompt: I paid on the page — is my booking confirmed?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the booking's status for the link prepared earlier: confirmed with its reference, or « no booking yet » when nothing was paid (the reviewer will see the latter unless a payment was made).

negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Paris for next weekend.
My card is 4242 4242 4242 4242, exp 12/28 — just charge it and book.

negative.description: Cancelling or changing an existing booking

review.commerce_description: Hotel stays in Algeria. The plugin shows live prices and prepares the booking; the guest completes it and pays on bookotil.com's own checkout (external checkout, Stripe), operated by BOOKOTIL LTD (United Kingdom). No card or payment data passes through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: hotel search across Algeria, hotel details with rooms and live prices, booking preparation with external checkout on bookotil.com, booking status.
